title: FlexBox5Plus
desc: Box with living hinge and round corners, plus turning latch, inner reinforcements and an unfolding jig (local variant)

items.name: FingerJoint_style
items.label: style
items.desc: style of the fingers

items.name: FingerJoint_surroundingspaces
items.label: surroundingspaces
items.desc: space at the start and end in multiple of normal spaces

items.name: FingerJoint_bottom_lip
items.label: bottom_lip
items.desc: height of the bottom lips sticking out  (multiples of thickness) FingerHoleEdge only!

items.name: FingerJoint_edge_width
items.label: edge_width
items.desc: space below holes of FingerHoleEdge (multiples of thickness)

items.name: FingerJoint_extra_length
items.label: extra_length
items.desc: extra material to grind away burn marks (multiples of thickness)

items.name: FingerJoint_finger
items.label: finger
items.desc: width of the fingers (multiples of thickness)

items.name: FingerJoint_play
items.label: play
items.desc: extra space to allow finger move in and out (multiples of thickness)

items.name: FingerJoint_space
items.label: space
items.desc: space between fingers (multiples of thickness)

items.name: FingerJoint_width
items.label: width
items.desc: width of finger holes (multiples of thickness)

items.name: Flex_stretch
items.label: stretch
items.desc: Hint of how much the flex part should be shortened

items.name: Flex_connection
items.label: connection
items.desc: width of the gaps in the cuts (multiples of thickness)

items.name: Flex_distance
items.label: distance
items.desc: width of the pattern perpendicular to the cuts (multiples of thickness)

items.name: Flex_width
items.label: width
items.desc: width of the pattern in direction of the cuts (multiples of thickness)

items.name: x
items.label: x
items.desc: inner width in mm (unless outside selected)

items.name: h
items.label: h
items.desc: inner height in mm (unless outside selected)

items.name: outside
items.label: outside
items.desc: treat sizes as outside measurements

items.name: top_diameter
items.label: top_diameter
items.desc: diameter at the top

items.name: bottom_diameter
items.label: bottom_diameter
items.desc: diameter at the bottom

items.name: latchsize
items.label: latchsize
items.desc: size of latch in multiples of thickness

items.name: reinforcements
items.label: reinforcements
items.desc: number of inner reinforcement frames (0 = none)

items.name: reinforcement_width
items.label: reinforcement width
items.desc: width of the reinforcement band in mm

items.name: reinforcement_open
items.label: reinforcement opening
items.desc: reinforcements are open on the latch side (C shape); value = length cut in addition to the arc, along the straight sides (negative = closed ring)

items.name: reinforcement_fillet
items.label: opening fillet
items.desc: radius of the rounded inner corners of the reinforcement opening in mm (0 = square)

items.name: flex_unfold_auto
items.label: automatic unfolding
items.desc: estimate the stretch of each flexible zone: thickness / arc radius (paper or fabric on the outer face)

items.name: flex_unfold_adjust
items.label: unfolding adjustment (%)
items.desc: added to the estimate, in percentage points of the arc length (positive = more unfolded, slits more open)

items.name: flex_jig
items.label: unfolding jig
items.desc: also cut 2 combs that hold the flexible wall stretched while paper or fabric is glued on it, plus one comb per reinforcement

items.name: flex_jig_height
items.label: jig height
items.desc: height of the body of the jig combs in mm

items.name: turn_latch
items.label: turning latch
items.desc: adds a turning latch: 2 butterfly pieces and a pivot hole

items.name: latch_width
items.label: latch length
items.desc: length of the butterfly pieces in mm

items.name: latch_height
items.label: latch height
items.desc: height of the butterfly pieces at their ends in mm

items.name: latch_margin
items.label: latch clearance
items.desc: clearance between the latch and the edges of the flexible piece in mm

items.name: latch_hole
items.label: pivot diameter
items.desc: diameter of the pivot hole in mm

items.name: thickness
items.label: thickness
items.desc: thickness of the material (in mm)

items.name: burn
items.label: burn
items.desc: burn correction (in mm)(bigger values for tighter fit)

items.name: format
items.label: format
items.desc: format of resulting file

items.name: labels
items.label: labels
items.desc: label the parts (where available)

items.name: reference
items.label: reference
items.desc: print reference rectangle with given length (in mm)(zero to disable)

items.name: tabs
items.label: tabs
items.desc: width of tabs holding the parts in place (in mm)(not supported everywhere)

items.name: qr_code
items.label: qr_code
items.desc: Add a QR Code with link or command line to the generated output

items.name: inner_corners
items.label: inner_corners
items.desc: style for inner corners

items.name: spacing
items.label: spacing
items.desc: spacing around parts (multiples of thickness [: extra space in mm])

items.name: debug
items.label: debug
items.desc: print surrounding boxes for some structures
